description: Searches the SEC EDGAR company directory by ticker or company name fragment and/or industry (SIC) and returns each match's CIK (the SEC's permanent company ID), primary ticker, name, exchange, industry (SIC code and description), and facts_rows (number of standardized financial fact rows loaded — >0 means financials are available). Use to find a company's identifiers before calling get_company or the financial tools; use get_company instead when you already hold a ticker or CIK and want one company's full profile. Read-only lookup of the stored directory; no API key. The directory covers all EDGAR filers and is refreshed from the SEC's ticker files; an exact ticker match ranks first, name matching is case-insensitive, a query over 40 characters is rejected, and industry-filtered lists sort covered companies first. Provide `query`, `sic`, and/or `sic_prefix` — at least one is required; `sic` is an exact industry match of 1-4 digits (e.g. '3674' semiconductors) and `sic_prefix` a 2-digit division match (e.g. '36' electronics).

query.description: Ticker symbol or company name fragment, e.g. 'NVDA' or 'nvidia' (max 40 characters)

sic.description: Exact SIC industry code, 1-4 digits, e.g. '3674' (semiconductors)

name: search_companies
